name: Announcement
description: A scheduled announcement widget: a short message with bold text and links, an optional button, start and end times, Spanish and English versions and three styles.
author: sap13ns

widgets.title: Announcement
widgets.description: A scheduled announcement with an optional link.

settings.label: Message
settings.help: Markdown-lite: **bold** and [links](https://…). Used when there is no message for the visitor's language. Empty hides the announcement.

settings.label: Message in Spanish
settings.help: Shown on Spanish pages instead of the message above.

settings.label: Message in English
settings.help: Shown on English pages instead of the message above.

settings.label: Button link
settings.help: https://…, http://… or a site path such as /blog/sale. Empty shows no button.

settings.label: Button label
settings.help: Empty uses "Learn more" ("Más información" on Spanish pages).

settings.label: Show until
settings.help: Same formats; the announcement disappears at this moment. A date alone includes that whole day. Empty: no end.

settings.label: Time zone
settings.help: IANA name, such as Europe/Madrid, for times written without an offset.
